name: Solarpunk Wiki
tagline: Solarpunk Wiki serves as a comprehensive unofficial database and field manual for the game Solarpunk
description: Solarpunk Wiki serves as a comprehensive unofficial database and field manual for the game Solarpunk. It provides meticulously verified data on items, buildings, crafting recipes, research, quests, and achievements. Every entry is cross-referenced with in-game values and official localization to ensure accuracy for players managing their sky homesteads.
